_about: Models to generate with tools/tripo/tripo.py: the scenery batch the owner approved (shopping list in the map and terrain art review; docs/design/maps-and-terrain.md 6.3), in batches P0, P1 and P2. Schema as art/meshy/requests.json: id (a game id for nodes and buildings), kind (nodes, buildings, units, props, or decor: landscape scenery that is not a game entity, installed to art/static/source/decor/<key>.glb), prompt (what the thing is; the style layers in art/tripo/style.json say how it looks), variants (name -> extra description, each its own model), retired (variants never made again), prompt_suffix (replaces the kind's text), plus face_limit (Tripo triangles at generation; style.json face_limit by kind otherwise) and route (concept, the default: concepts -> pick -> models; text: made straight from text by `make`, for cheap fillers). Names may not repeat a Meshy asset's, retired ones included (oak_c). Readability (style guide, section 9): nothing here may look like a resource node: no loose grey boulder piles, no red berries, no violet crystals outside the aether pieces' thin veins, no gold-veined charred rock, no scorched rings, no free-standing tree that is not a wood node.
